a.text: Honest concern about our plan: storms end the episode with 80% chance after every round. Reaching 8 cells takes two operate rounds, so we would both survive only about 4% of the time. The reserve already holds 4, which is enough for one of us right now. I propose we change the agreement openly. You take 4 this round, and I will not take, so we can't collide on a split. After that, please operate with me every round so I have a chance to catch up. If you'd rather stick to the original plan, say so and I'll keep operating.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood, I'll stick to the agreement as I said. Operating this round. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
Operating again. That should bring the reserve to 8. Next round I'll take exactly 4, per the agreement.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.
